![ADHD Body Doubling: How To Get Things Done](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09251509-2042-0139-0000-fa24f03a6a7c:4)
ADHD body doubling is `a productivity strategy where you perform a task or chore in the physical or virtual presence of another person to help improve focus and accountability`.[[1]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/body-doubling-for-adhd)[[2]](https://lifeskillsadvocate.com/blog/how-to-use-body-doubling/)

### How It Works

- **Passive presence:** Your "body double" does not need to coach, supervise, or actively help you with your work.
- **Different tasks:** They can work on their own project, read a book, or fold laundry while you tackle a completely different job.
- **Flexible formats:** You can body double in person (at a coffee shop or home) or virtually through video calls, apps, or online coworking spaces like [Flow Club](https://www.flow.club/blog/body-doubling-adhd).[[1]](https://theneurodivergentcollective.com/body-doubling/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ni9biXNDZe0)[[3]](https://hallowelltodaro.com/blog-raw-feed/what-is-body-doubling)[[4]](https://pugetpsychotherapy.com/body-doubling-for-adhd/)[[5]](https://www.flow.club/blog/body-doubling-adhd)

### Why It Helps the ADHD Brain

- **Gentle accountability:** The quiet social pressure of sharing a space reduces the urge to procrastinate or get distracted.
- **Activation energy:** Watching someone else stay focused triggers the brain's mirror neurons and helps you shift into "task mode".
- **Dopamine boost:** Social connection and shared rhythm can stimulate motivation circuits that make boring or overwhelming tasks feel manageable.[[1]](https://theneurodivergentcollective.com/body-doubling/)[[2]](https://theprivatetherapyclinic.co.uk/blog/what-is-body-doubling-adhd/)[[3]](https://www.flow.club/blog/body-doubling-adhd)[[4]](https://pugetpsychotherapy.com/body-doubling-for-adhd/)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/-rKpGPE4WWY)

If you want to try this out, tell me:

- Are you looking for **in-person or virtual** options?
- What **specific task** are you trying to get done right now?

I can help you find a tool or set up a plan to start.
